description: Find verses that contain these exact words. Use this for a quote or a specific phrase, like "Jesus wept". Defaults to ULT if it is downloaded, otherwise the first downloaded Bible. Works even when topic search is not set up.

limit.description: How many verses to return, 1-50. Default 20

query.description: Exact words to find, like Jesus wept

resource.description: Which Bible, like en_ult. Leave off to use ULT or the first downloaded Bible

name: search_lexical
